Scan code (operationCode). 【country】已妥投 (delivered abroad).
Scan code (operationCode). 已试投/投递失败(...) (delivery attempted); its state label still reads 运送中.
Scan code (operationCode). 您的邮件已代签收…成功退回至寄件人 (returned to the sender); the text carries a signer and phones, so the state label 已退回 is shown.
